Input images: Image 1 is the exact existing ILBI brand logo: distinctive lowercase black i/dot, blue flowing ribbon and black curved bowl; reproduce this symbol faithfully with small lowercase "ilbi.uz" wordmark, never replace it with plain uppercase ILBI. In dark mode the black parts become warm white and the blue ribbon remains blue. Image 2 is the user-approved compact cart and phone-frame style reference. Image 3 is the user-approved day/night palette and left sidebar reference. Keep the SAME mobile design system across all outputs; references are style/brand references, not pictures to place within the screens.
Composition: LANDSCAPE wide high-resolution presentation board, exactly THREE fully visible straight upright front-facing modern smartphone mockups, same scale and realistic small camera cutout, with generous gaps on a quiet warm-white studio background. Each device completely within frame including status bar and bottom edge; labels outside devices remain separate from UI. Use large sharp readable Uzbek Latin text and realistic simple line icons. Avoid tilted phones, ornamental 3D objects, blur, tiny illegible tables, oversized headings and huge empty decorative areas. Show the app running INSIDE each phone. 
Brand palette from desktop: light background warm white #F0EFEB, white surfaces, near-black #0B0909 text and primary buttons. Strong visible field label "Dona narxi", bordered value "12 000" with pencil; this is the selling price for this customer. Every other row follows the consistent data. Sticky total161 000 and black "To'lovga o'tish", bottom Savdo active.
Phone caption "22B · Narxni kiritish": LIGHT phone with compact focused bottom sheet over same dimmed cart, not a separate settings page. Sheet title "Mijozga sotuv narxi", product "Sut 1 L", large legible input "11 500" and "so'm / dona", calculation "2 dona × 11 500 = 23 000 so'm", helper "Faqat shu savdo uchun". Phone caption "22C · Narx qo'llandi": DARK cart with SAME tiny thumbnails, eight or more compact rows, milk 2 ×11 500, milk line total23 000, correct grand total160 000.
